prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Conroe, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1386; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the rear-end collision you were involved in in Conroe, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just give you the facts, but fine. I'm the driver of the vehicle that was struck from behind.

Q: Understood. Can you walk me through what happened leading up to the impact?

A: I was stopped at a red light on a main road, waiting in the right lane. Traffic was moving pretty steadily, and I'd come to a full stop maybe a few seconds before it happened.

Q: Did you notice the other vehicle approaching?

A: Not really. I saw it in the mirror for a second, but I was looking ahead at the signal. Then there was a hard jolt from behind and my head snapped forward and back.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did your vehicle leave the lane or move at all after the impact?

A: It got pushed forward a little, into the intersection area, but I got it out of the way fairly quickly.

Q: Have you been seen by a medical provider since the collision?

A: Yes. I went to urgent care the same afternoon. My right knee hit the dashboard and it's swollen and painful. I've been using crutches for a few days, and the doctor ordered an MRI.

Q: Are you still experiencing pain or limited movement?

A: Yes. Stairs are difficult, and I can't stand for long periods. I've missed several days of work because of it.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Just that I want my injuries documented accurately, and I'm willing to provide my medical records.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
